jobs.description:
Job Description
H&M is reshaping the future of promotions and customer incentives at a global scale! We are driving a major transformation across all our channels, involving significant architectural improvements, and unlocking endless business opportunities. 
We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong experience in backend development using Java to help drive and deliver our ongoing initiatives. Join us in redefining the tech landscape and building innovative solutions that create impact worldwide. 
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
Creating and delivering technical solutions to business challenges 
Delivering software solutions that run globally and impact millions of customers 
Develop in both spec-driven development fashion with AI agents and in traditional way 
Use engineering expertise to ensure AI-generated and manually developed solutions meet quality, performance, security, and maintainability standards, and participating in increasing said standards 
Maintain and contribute to the team’s strong collaboration culture 
Work on tests and automation around it 

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH  
You will be part of one of our dedicated product teams, collaborating closely with colleagues to bring these transformations to life. You are passionate about programming and take pride in delivering high-quality, polished solutions. As a developer, you have a genuine interest in the technology you work with, always striving to build a strong tech foundation that supports future ventures. You are eager to be involved in various parts of the development process: from design, build, test, deploy, monitor and maintain.   
We value teamwork, and we are looking for someone with excellent interpersonal skills who thrives in a dynamic, fun and engaging professional environment. If this sounds exciting, we want to hear from you!  
WHO YOU ARE  
Somone who is used to work in very collaborative fashion 
Hands on experience of end-to-end development in a microservice and cloud environment - from idea, design, build, test, deploy, monitor and running microservices at global scale in production  
3 to 5 years' experience in developing and testing applications/components  
Experience with Kubernetes and container technologies, such as Docker  
Advanced level of Java 21+ and prior working experience with Spring Boot and Spring Framework  
Practical experience developing though specification-driven development with LLMs 
Experience developing with AI agents, including effective context management, tool integration, and agent orchestration 
Creating, running and maintaining testing setups including component, integration and performance tests 
Automation through CI/CD pipelines including continuous deployment  
Excellent in English communication 

Nice to have:  
Have experience creating and running applications with LLMs and MCPs in production 
Ability to design and structure data models and knowledge repositories that enable reliable AI and agent-based solutions 
Hands-on experience integrating AI agent workflows with traditional engineering practices, such as CI/CD, test automation and automation of deployments 
Experience working in, or helping teams transition to, AI-agent-enabled development processes and ways of working. 
Experience with Azure, GCP 
Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform  
Database experience, such as NoSQL 

WHO WE ARE  
H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.  
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we use our scale and knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.  
All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)  
Staff discount usable across all H&M Group brands, in stores and online  
Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation, and wellness allowance of 4000 SEK/year  
Access to Benify for discounts on gym memberships, travel, hotels, and more  
Compensation boost during parental leave  

JOIN US  
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it is our people who make us who we are.  
This is a full-time, permanent position, starting as soon as possible according to agreement. The role is hybrid, based in Stockholm, Sweden, where close collaboration with stakeholders is an important part of the role.  
Apply by submitting your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page. Application deadline 5th oct 2026 
We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter.

Join Telavox as a Systems Engineer for Storage
Are you a hands-on systems engineer who thrives in operational depth and wants to own the storage that the rest of engineering runs on? At Telavox, we run our own: our own Ceph clusters, on-prem Kubernetes, and a fleet of physical servers across six countries. We're providers of infrastructure, not consumers of cloud - a deliberate choice, and what our product and economics demand. Storage is where we're investing next.
Ceph specifically is not a requirement. If you've run distributed or enterprise storage in production - Ceph, ZFS, Gluster, Lustre, MinIO, a vendor array - the instincts are what we're after, and we'll teach you ours.
About the job
This is a hands-on operations role. You'd own how our storage runs day-to-day - health, capacity, upgrades, expansion, and the operational foundations underneath it. You'll have real input into architecture, and you'll set the long-term direction with our storage lead rather than on your own. The emphasis here is deliberately operational - if making storage actually work, and being trusted to do it unsupervised, is the part you want, there's a lot of room in this role.
Ceph (block and S3) is our main estate - real production storage, growing across regions, with Sweden the largest footprint.
Your day-to-day would be mostly spent on things like:

Keeping the clusters healthy - issues, monitoring, capacity planning, upgrades, and expansion across regions

Getting the foundations right: stability, security, predictable scaling.

Making the work repeatable - runbooks, upgrade procedures that hold across regions, automation for what's manual today

You won't work in isolation from the rest of the platform: on-prem Kubernetes runs most of our workloads and has clear impact on the storage domain, and our Ansible-driven server and OS fleet spans six countries

How we work together:
You’ll join our Infrastructure Engineering team of around 15 people, working from our Malmö HQ, Gjuteriet, with international colleagues working remotely. English is our working language, and Swedish is a bonus.
There’s no mandatory on-call rotation, although Compute and Storage have an informal secondary list. You’ll have real ownership from day one, with plenty of room to identify, propose, and implement improvements. We also use Claude Code across Engineering, and you’ll help explore how it can support our platform work.
About you
You treat automation as the direction and repetition as its trigger, you factor in risk from the start rather than discovering it at the end, and you're pragmatic enough to do the manual work until automation catches up.
We're looking for:

Real operational depth in distributed or enterprise storage - a system you've run in production, been on the hook for, and debugged under pressure. Which system matters far less than how deeply

Strong Linux fundamentals - the substrate everything else sits on

Comfort taking an unclear problem, scoping it, and seeing it through

We strongly value experience with Ceph or object storage at scale, Ansible or similar configuration management, and operating systems across distributed environments. Experience with on-prem Kubernetes, server/OS lifecycle management, or firmware, BIOS, and BMC/IPMI is also a plus.
We’re looking for someone at a mid-to-senior level, with growth focused on deeper expertise, broader ownership, and becoming the go-to person for storage across the organisation.
Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don't focus on fitting in; we focus on making room for everyone.
We’re always on the lookout for great talent, so applications are reviewed continuously. If you're ready to be part of an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, apply today with your CV and cover letter in English. 
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Emil Nilsson, Engineering Manager emil.nilsson@telavox.com. 
Learn more about what we do! ⬇️

We're looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to take ownership of the platform that powers our data products, from real-time APIs our customers depend on to the batch pipelines behind our analytics. You'll work across a lambda architecture that combines a low-latency streaming layer built in Go with a batch layer on Google Cloud, running on infrastructure spread across AWS, Azure, and GCP in regions around the world.
This is a hands-on senior role with real technical leadership. Beyond building and maintaining the platform, you'll set the bar for engineering quality on the team, shape how we design services so they stay modular and scalable as we grow, and act as tech lead and mentor for junior engineers.
Build and evolve the data platform
Develop and maintain our real-time layer, including the Go-based gateway and processing engine that serve customer-facing workloads with high availability and low latency.
Own and improve the batch layer on GCP, working with BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt to deliver reliable, well-modelled, and cost-efficient pipelines.
Keep the speed and batch layers consistent with each other, making sure data is correct, reconcilable, and trustworthy regardless of which path it takes.

Design and ship customer-facing backend services
Design, build, and operate backend APIs that customers use directly, with strong attention to contracts, versioning, performance, and backwards compatibility.
Think through failure modes, observability, and scaling up front, so services behave predictably in production.

Own multi-cloud infrastructure
Manage and evolve our infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP in multiple global regions using Terraform.
Improve how we structure infrastructure code through reusable modules, sensible environment separation, and safe, repeatable deployments.
Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, security, and cost visibility across clouds. Participate in a shared on-call rotation for production systems.

Raise the bar on engineering excellence
Define and champion engineering standards around code quality, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation.
Lead technical design discussions and write clear design documents for significant changes, bringing the team along in the reasoning.
Identify technical debt and architectural weak points and build a pragmatic plan to address them alongside feature work.

Lead and mentor
Serve as tech lead for the team, guiding technical direction and helping prioritize work (this role has no direct reports).
Mentor two junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and gradually increasing ownership, helping them grow into confident, independent engineers.

REQUIREMENTS 
Significant professional experience as a software or data engineer (typically 6+ years), including time spent owning production systems end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals: clean and modular design, testing strategies, API design, and an understanding of distributed systems trade-offs.
Experience building and operating backend services in a compiled or typed language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Rust, or similar.
Hands-on experience with a modern data stack, ideally BigQuery, Airflow, and dbt or close equivalents.
Solid experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, and working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider in depth.
Familiarity with both real-time/streaming and batch data processing patterns, and the challenges of combining them.
A track record of mentoring others and raising the quality of the teams you've been part of.
Clear written and verbal communication, especially the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to engineers of varying experience.

Nice to have
Professional experience with Go. This is a strong plus, though we'll happily support an experienced backend engineer in going deep on it.
Experience running infrastructure across multiple clouds and regions, including networking, identity, and data residency considerations.
Background with lambda or kappa architectures, event streaming systems (such as Kafka or Pub/Sub), or high-throughput API gateways.
Experience with observability tooling (metrics, tracing, logging) and cloud cost optimization.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This is a hybrid role based in Stockholm, Sweden, and reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. 
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Job Description
WHAT YOU WILL DO
As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store-ready workforce plans. Rather than managing day-to-day staffing, you design and evolve the workforce planning logic that determines how stores are staffed across markets and formats.
You will help define how customer demand, traffic patterns, operational workload and labour standards are translated into workforce requirements, ensuring staffing is realistic, compliant, fair and scalable.
You will:
Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
Translate customer demand, operational workload and labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
Create and maintain shift templates aligned with customer traffic patterns, demand peaks and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel operations
Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes, productivity improvements and new store initiatives
Develop workforce planning logic that reflects store operations, customer flow and workload drivers across retail formats
Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into global workforce planning standards
Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure labour standards, workload assumptions and demand drivers are accurately reflected in staffing logic
Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate planning rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
Provide expert guidance and support to markets on workforce planning, staffing logic and scheduling principles
Support root-cause analysis and continuous improvement related to workforce productivity, staffing effectiveness and scheduling performance

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
You will work closely with Sales Markets, Labour Standards and Labour Demand teams, Tech and WFM product teams, as well as global Retail Operations and Controlling stakeholders. In this role, you act as a subject-matter expert and trusted partner, helping connect labour standards, workload drivers and operational realities with practical workforce planning solutions.
WHO YOU ARE
You are a structured and analytical expert who understands both the logic behind workforce planning and the realities of physical retail operations. You enjoy translating complex operational challenges into practical and scalable workforce planning solutions.
We are looking for people with:
Deep experience within workforce planning, workforce design, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems
Strong understanding of retail, logistics, field operations or other customer-facing operational environments where staffing is driven by workload, customer demand and operational activities
Experience translating demand drivers, workload assumptions or productivity standards into staffing requirements and scheduling rules
Strong understanding of operational planning, workforce deployment and labour productivity
Solid knowledge of labour regulations and scheduling compliance requirements
Experience translating analytical models, operational rules or workforce logic into practical guidance and scalable ways of working
Strong documentation skills and high attention to detail
Confidence working cross-functionally and influencing without formal authority
Fluency in English, both written and spoken

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together we want to use our power, our scale and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. Read more about us here
WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
At H&M Group we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
An example of our benefits:
25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
H&M Incentive Programme – HIP. Learn more about the programme here.

JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
This is a permanent position based in Stockholm, please send your CV in English as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​
 
About Beyond Gravity
Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. In 2024, the company generated a revenue of around CHF 359 million. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com
 
Your crew

We are a team of more than 10 professionals. Our expertise includes product assurance, managing product project quality from customer quotation to project closure, as well as quality assurance, ensuring that our manufacturing quality meets the agreed-upon criteria. 
We ensure that the high level of quality demanded by our international customers is always achieved for our space products.
The entire department has a very diverse structure in terms of age, experience, knowledge, education and nationalities.
We are proud of the strong team spirit in our department, warmly welcome new members and prioritize the training of new employees.
 
 
Your mission
 
Responsibilities:
Develop the Quality Assurance Requirements and Culture, ensuring robust quality processes, cost excellence for program quality execution through collaboration with engineering, operations and supply chain.
Act as main interface for Process Engineering and Operations for all quality and safety topics
Establish Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) features in collaboration with Process Engineering and Operations
Lead Non-Conformance and failure investigation whenever product and/or process requirements are violated
Supervise and direct Internal Manufacturing Assembly Integration and Test (MAIT) Process Development and Qualification for all relevant quality aspects
Perform Key Inspection Point (KIP) and Mandatory Inspection Point (MIP) Documentation (Production Records) to verify Critical Features/Requirements

Main Tasks:
Execute Quality Assurance Program in accordance with Project Milestones
Ensure successful execution of the Customer, Regulatory and Internal Requirements for Operations Execution
Convert the Customer Critical to Quality Requirements into internal specifications and requirements
Lead and coordinate the Internal Process for Non-Conformance Management
Lead Operations Critical Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and investigation activities
Moderate Process FMEA
Develop Process Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) and Control Plans in collaboration with Process Engineering and Operations
Establish Process Quality Documentation
Support Process Qualification
Contribute for Quality matters to proposal as part of the Request For Information / Request For Quotation
Contribute as needed to Customer and Internal Audit as Quality Assurance representative.
Contribute to the Quality Organization Development (Training/Coaching)

Most important output:
Contribute to Customer Satisfaction for Quality Performance
Operations Quality Performance
Process FMEA
Process Critical-to-Quality (CTQs) and Control Plans
Input to the Product Quality data-package for Space Application 
Input to the Final Product Qualification data-package for Space Application 
Internal Root Cause Analysis and Non-Conformance Report

 
Your story

Must's:
Relevant experience in the field of Quality and Continuous Improvement
Preferred education: BSc/MSc degree in Engineering or in a similar relevant discipline
Knowledge of standards such as EN9100, ECSS, NASA and MIL
Ability to quickly understand and analyze technical products/systems and their function
High level of theoretical skills in relevant fields with an adeptness to coach hands on practical elements “on the floor”
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
MS Office experience required
Experience in the application of Quality preventive methodology (5Why, Ishikawa Fishbone…)

Nice to have:
Any further language (German, French and Swedish) beyond English is a strong asset
Experience in other Space companies

 
Why Beyond Gravity
To work in a growing high technology company with career opportunities within the site or internationally.
You will be a part of an engaged team with the ambition to innovate space!
We offer a hybrid work situation, high flexibility and autonomy, and a great team to develop and have fun with!

 
🌌Are you ready for lift-off?​
Our core values - Passionate, Together, and Curious - transform challenges into opportunities. Embark on a journey to transcend the ordinary with us. We‘re actively reviewing candidates and will promptly select the ideal fit for our team.​
​
For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact: ​Breno Silva | breno.silva@beyondgravity.com 
​
Beyond Gravity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected categories.​
​
Applications by e-mail cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruitment agencies for this position.

Join our Women's Jersey team as a Junior Designer and play a hands-on role in creating fashion that reaches customers around the world. From the first sketch to the final sample, you’ll be right at the heart of the design process—helping shape collections that launch across all H&M markets and omni channels, reaching millions of customers globally.
You’ll work within women’s jersey bringing fresh ideas and a strong fashion point of view to everything you create. You’ll develop concepts, create technical sketches, support fittings and follow your designs through the sample process, working closely with the wider team to turn ideas into beautifully executed product.
You’ll collaborate with a dynamic mix of Designers, Product Developers, Planners, Pattern Makers and Product Managers, learning from experts across the business while contributing your own perspective.
We’re looking for someone who instinctively understands trends, silhouette, colour and detail—and knows how to translate them into product that feels relevant, desirable and commercially strong.
You’ll bring curiosity to the process, challenge ideas, spot opportunities and help create jersey collections that feel fresh, modern and unmistakably H&M. You’ll balance fashion impact with commercial awareness, always thinking about the customer and how great design can work at scale.
This is a chance to level up your design career in a fast-moving, international environment. You’ll gain hands-on experience across the full design journey, learn from a global team and see your ideas become product worn by customers all over the world.
If you’re curious, collaborative and constantly inspired by fashion, with the confidence to bring new ideas to the table and the flexibility to make them happen, we want to hear from you.

Experience in creating specs and technical files

⚡️ What We Do Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.
Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.
🌟Who We Are  Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.
At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.
To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a commercially driven and strategic VP of Project Delivery & Operations. 

👩‍💻 About The Role: Flower develops, builds and operates utility-scale BESS assets across Sweden, Germany, France, Belgium, the Netherlands and Austria. As our portfolio moves from development into construction and operation, we’re bringing EPC and Asset Management together in a new division, Project Delivery & Operations and we’re looking for the leader who will build it.
In this senior leadership role, you’ll unite the two functions into one scalable, end-to-end offering across the full project and asset lifecycle, delivering for Flower’s own portfolio and growing it into a commercial offering for external customers. You’ll set the division’s long-term direction, shape how we show up in the BESS and renewable energy market and turn that direction into commercial success.
As a core member of the management team, you’ll own the division’s strategy and market positioning, as well as the P&L for Flower’s asset portfolio: 200 MWh in operation today and another 1.1 GWh ready-to-build. You’ll also help shape company-wide priorities, lead leaders across both functions and build a team that is as strong in front of customers as it is in delivery.
What You’ll Do:

Define and own the long-term strategy for Project Delivery & Operations

Lead through managers - Head of EPC & Head of Asset Management

Integrate EPC and Asset Management into one coherent growth platform, grounded in market and customer insight

Own the P&L for the division and Flower’s asset portfolio, providing clear financial reporting and forecasting to the management team and board

Turn our in-house EPC and Asset Management capabilities into a clear, differentiated offering for external BESS owners and developers, across the full asset lifecycle

Drive strong cost management across construction and operations: capex and opex control, accurate cost-to-complete forecasting and continuous cost-down through procurement and standardization

Play a central role in project financing and investor processes, ensuring our EPC and O&M setup is bankable, working closely with lenders, investors and their technical advisors through due diligence

Develop scalable commercial models, pricing frameworks and service models that support repeatable growth without a proportional increase in complexity or cost

Own the commercial agenda: build senior customer relationships, identify opportunities and close deals

Contribute to company-wide priorities as a member of the management team, ensuring the division is aligned with Flower’s overall strategy

Who You Are:

You have a proven track record in a senior commercial leadership role, ideally within renewable energy, BESS, energy infrastructure or other project-driven sectors

You’re an experienced people leader, used to leading through managers and bringing teams together across the organisation

Master’s degree in Engineering, Business or a related field

You have taken service offerings or business models to market, with a strong instinct for what customers value and how to package and price it

Experience of cost control in capital-intensive projects, supporting project financing, technical due diligence or investor processes

You’ve developed and executed divisional or business-unit strategy, and know how to turn market opportunity into a structured plan

You’re strongly commercial, motivated by growth and comfortable owning a P&L

You have a solid understanding of EPC project delivery and/or asset operations, enough to engage credibly with customers and technical teams (deep technical expertise is not required)

You’ve built senior customer relationships and driven growth in complex, long-cycle businesses 

📍 Location Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm just a short walk from Slussen subway station.
✉️ Apply Our corporate language is English, as we have over 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English. 
We look forward to hearing from you!

About Univrses
Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
The Mission
The Backbone of Operations: Every 3DAI™ deployment starts with a phone and a holder in a box. You make sure devices are set up, tested and shipped across Europe on time and fully traceable.

Quality at the Source: Our AI is only as good as its data. You help keep our annotation work accurate and on schedule.

The Heart of the Office: You shape the everyday experience of 40 scientists, engineers and business builders in our bright office by the water in Hammarby Sjöstad.

Established yet Agile: Founded in 2015, we have the stability of an established firm with the speed of a startup.

The Role
A hands-on, varied role spanning data, hardware, logistics and workplace. No two days look the same, and you'll be the go-to person who makes things happen.

Data Annotation & Quality: Annotate, re-annotate and validate data, monitor quality standards, and troubleshoot annotation tools.

Annotation Team Support: Help annotators meet productivity, quality and deadline targets. Train new annotators and answer questions about processes and tools.

Device Setup: Charge, configure and install apps on phones and car phone holders, create user accounts per internal guidelines, and test every device before it ships.

Packaging & Shipping: Pack collection kits according to checklists, label and document contents, ship via our providers, and log tracking so all hardware is traceable.

Inventory Management: Keep device and accessory inventory up to date, run regular stock checks, and initiate replenishment when stock runs low.

Office Coordination: Organise weekly team breakfast and Lunch & Learns (polls, food orders and all), manage office hardware, and handle deliveries, including pickups from local collection points.

Workplace Environment: Keep the office tidy and welcoming, from desks and fridges to fresh flowers, and proactively improve how we work.

Who You Are
Organised by Nature: You love structure, checklists and accurate records.

Hands-on and Practical: You're comfortable unboxing deliveries, setting up a phone, packing a shipment and fixing a basic tech issue, all in the same afternoon.

Detail-oriented: Whether validating annotations or labelling a package, you get it right the first time.

Service-minded: You enjoy helping colleagues and making the workplace better for everyone.

What You Bring
Required:

Experience: Background in office coordination, administration, operations, logistics or a similar hands-on role.

Tech Comfort: Confident setting up smartphones and apps and quick to learn new tools.

Accuracy: A track record of maintaining precise records, inventories or quality-controlled work.

Communication: Fluent English, with the ability to explain processes clearly and train others.

Preferred:

Experience with data annotation, labelling or quality assurance work.

Experience with inventory management, shipping or e-commerce logistics.

Swedish language skills.

AI-tool literacy — using AI to speed up your own workflows and problem-solving.

Driving licence.

What's in It for You?
We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work keeps our operations running.

Variety and Growth: Gain exposure to AI data workflows, hardware deployment and international logistics, with real room to shape how we work.

The "Work-Life" Blend: A culture that values output over "desk time". Overtime is rare, something you don't find in many tech startups.

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:
Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns with internal or external speakers, with catered lunch paid by the company.

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week's wins at Friday After Work (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!).

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Are You Our Next Office Manager and Data Annotator?
If you're an organised, hands-on problem solver who loves keeping things running smoothly, we want to hear from you.
To apply, please include the following:

Your CV

A cover letter

Note: All application materials must be in English.

ABOUT THE ROLE
 
We are seeking a hands-on, technically fluent engineer to drive the adoption of AI across our entire development organization - someone who finds the friction in how teams work and turns it into automated, AI-powered solutions.
As our AI Enablement Engineer, you will embed with engineering and product teams to identify where AI can remove repetitive, manual work, then build and ship the solutions that make it happen. You will work closely with our AI Efficiency Architects and AI Evangelist to turn high-level AI strategy into concrete, measurable wins on the ground.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, moves fast, and gets real satisfaction from seeing their work adopted and relied upon by teams across the company.
 
Your Mission
Accelerate how the entire development organization works by finding high-impact use cases for AI, building the solutions that automate them, and spreading those wins so they scale across teams.
 
 
 
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
 

Use Case Discovery: work directly with engineering and product teams to map their workflows, spot repetitive or slow processes, and identify the highest-impact opportunities for AI-driven automation across the development organization.
Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: act as a builder - lead the technical design and implementation of working solutions such as prompt workflows, lightweight agents, scripts, and integrations that prove value fast, then partnering with the AI Efficiency Architects to harden anything that needs to run in production.
Reusable Enablement Assets: create templates, playbooks, and repeatable patterns so a proven AI win can spread from one team to many without bespoke work each time.
Adoption & Measurement: drive genuine adoption of AI tooling across teams and tie every solution back to concrete outcomes - time saved, throughput, and delivery speed - so impact is visible and quantifiable to leadership.
Feedback to the Platform: surface recurring needs and friction back to the AI Efficiency Architects, so the internal AI gateway and tooling evolve toward what teams actually need.
Technical Mentorship & Influence: mentor senior engineers on AI best practices and influence engineering roadmaps.

 
 
OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:
 
ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Staff-Level Engineering Foundations: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience (Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript) with a proven track record of delivering complex, distributed systems in a production environment.
Production-Ready AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience moving AI from a cool prototype to a real-world tool. You don’t just write basic prompts - you know how to build reliable agents and RAG workflows, and you understand the practical side of LLMs, like managing costs, speed, and context limits to make tools actually work for production.
Strategic Problem-Solving: You have a strong bias for action and can take a vague problem and turn it into a working solution fast. While you focus on delivering value quickly rather than chasing perfection, you always think big - building smart, reusable tools that fix root problems for hundreds of developers, not just one team.
Collaboration & Communication: excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work alongside many different teams, understand their needs, and bring them along on the adoption journey.
SDLC/DevOps Familiarity: working knowledge of the tools that underpin the software delivery lifecycle (e.g., GitLab/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, source control) so that solutions fit naturally into how teams already work.
Self-Direction: capacity to manage a varied portfolio of work across multiple teams, prioritize for impact, and deliver with minimal supervision.

 
NICE TO HAVES

Excellent presentation and training skills
Previous experience running enablement, developer experience, or internal tooling initiatives

 
 
WHO WE ARE
 
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
 
 
BENEFITS
 

Hybrid work policy
4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
30 annual vacation days
Occupational Pension
5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
Parental Leave Top-Up
Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner
1,500 SEK equipment allowance
Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts

 
In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!
 
Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!

Take Ownership of Building Semin's Presence in the Nordic Market
Semin Group is investing in the Nordic market, and we're looking for someone who wants to be at the centre of that growth. As one of Europe's leading manufacturers of fillers, joint compounds and interior finishing solutions, Semin has built a strong presence across multiple European markets. We are now looking for a National Sales Developer to help establish and grow our business across the Nordic region.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities and developing business in the construction industry. You'll be responsible for introducing the Semin brand, developing customer relationships and building a strong market presence across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. While your activities may initially be focused on your local market, your role will contribute to Semin's growth across the Nordics.
If you enjoy being out with customers, developing new business and taking ownership of your results, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity
Your mission is simple: Build Semin's position across the Nordic region.
While your initial activities may be concentrated in your local market, your responsibility will extend across Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. You will identify new business opportunities, develop relationships with key customers and distributors, and help establish Semin as a recognised partner throughout the Nordic construction industry.
You will have significant freedom to shape your approach, influence market development, and create new business opportunities across the region. Working closely with colleagues across Europe, you'll play a direct role in strengthening Semin's Nordic presence and supporting the company's continued international growth.

Your Responsibilities

Identify and develop new business opportunities

Build relationships with distributors, builders' merchants, wholesalers and key decision-makers

Introduce Semin's products and solutions to the market

Win new customers and grow existing business opportunities

Visit customers and maintain a strong presence in the field

Represent Semin at industry events, trade fairs and exhibitions

Develop and execute your own business development strategy

Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline

Monitor market trends, customer needs and competitor activity

Work closely with international colleagues to support growth and customer success

Who We Are Looking For
You understand how the construction industry works. You know how to build relationships, identify opportunities and convert them into business. Most importantly, you enjoy creating something new rather than simply maintaining what already exists.

We believe you have:

At least 3 years of B2B sales experience within the construction industry

A proven track record in new business development

Experience working with distributors, builders’ merchants, wholesalers or related sales channels

A strong network within the construction sector

Experience managing your own territory and customer relationships

Excellent communication skills in English

Fluency in Swedish or Danish

A valid driving license

Meritorious

Experience introducing products or brands into new markets

Experience selling fillers, drywall systems, construction chemicals, insulation

products or similar solutions

Experience working in an international organisation

Experience working remotely and independently

You'll Succeed in This Role If You

Enjoy meeting customers and building relationships

Are motivated by finding and winning new business

Take initiative and work well independently

Are resilient and comfortable overcoming obstacles

Enjoy travel and spending time in the field

Have an entrepreneurial mindset

Want to have a direct impact on business growth

This role involves extensive travel and regular customer visits. Success comes from being visible in the market, understanding customer needs and building long-term relationships.

What Semin Offers
At Semin, you'll join a successful European manufacturer while enjoying the autonomy and influence often associated with a much smaller business.

You will receive:

The opportunity to build and develop a market with significant growth potential

Real ownership and responsibility

Direct access to international decision-makers

Product and company training in France

A dedicated mentor during onboarding

Support from experienced colleagues across Europe

An international working environment

A competitive compensation package

The opportunity to play a visible role in Semin's future growth in the Nordic region

Location
The position is home-based and can be located in Sweden or Denmark.
The successful candidate will initially focus on developing Semin's position within their local market while working closely with colleagues across Europe.

Ready to Build Something?
If you're excited by the opportunity to develop a market, build strong customer relationships and play a visible role in a growing international business, we'd love to hear from you.
Please submit your CV in English.
Join Semin and help establish the next chapter of our Nordic growth journey.

Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

Structured and patient-oriented

At Catalytic Technology, we help our customers transform ideas into successful products. We work with electronics, embedded software, FPGA design, system engineering and technical project leadership across a wide range of industries.
We are a small and highly experienced team of engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges and working closely with our customers. As demand for our expertise continues to grow, we are looking for an Electronics Engineer to strengthen our Gothenburg office.
About the role
As an Electronics Engineer at Catalytic, you will play a key role in developing advanced embedded and electronic systems. You will be part of a journey where we transition from traditional consulting to inhouse product development.
Your key responsibilities will be:
Electronics architecture and system design
Schematic capture and component selection
Design verification and validation, including board bring-up

We believe you have
MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related technical field
Several years of experience in electronics development
Experience with schematic design and PCB development
Enthusiasm for using different AI-tools, but you don't depend on them
Good understanding of digital electronics
Experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers and spectrum analysers
Strong communication skills in English

The following are considered valuable merits:
PCB design and layout
Embedded software development in C/C++
FPGA or programmable logic experience
EMC and compliance testing
Mixed-signal and/or power electronics design
Industrialisation and production transfer experience
Experience from industrial, telecom, automotive, defence or medical applications

What we offer
At Catalytic, you become part of a highly skilled engineering team.
We offer:
A small company environment with short decision paths
Experienced colleagues with broad engineering expertise
Opportunities to influence technical direction and company growth
Flexible working conditions

About Catalytic Technology
The people at Catalytic Technology develop electronic and embedded products from concept to production. We combine expertise in systems engineering, FPGA development, embedded software, electronics design and project management to help customers bring innovative products to market.

Your role
Do you want to play a key role in ensuring that customers and our global Service organization have access to the right spare parts at the right time?
 
As a Spare Parts Specialist, you will bridge product development and aftermarket operations by managing spare parts information throughout the product lifecycle. Working with a global portfolio of primarily mechanical products, you will collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Service, Supply Chain, and Product Management to ensure high-quality spare parts data, strong aftermarket readiness, and continuous improvement of our processes and tools. 
 
What you will do:
Maintain and develop spare parts information throughout the product lifecycle
Create and maintain technical documentation, product structures, exploded-view illustrations, and recommended spare parts lists
Support new product introductions and ensure aftermarket readiness
Perform spare parts pricing based on defined pricing formulas and principles
Support the global Service organization with technical spare parts expertise
Drive improvements in data quality, digital tools, and ways of working

Join our customer in Ludvika and play a key role in optimizing long-term production plans within a highly complex manufacturing environment.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken

jobs.occupation: Extra Staff – Housekeeper/Cleaner at Carotte Housekeeping, Gothenburg
jobs.description:
ABOUT US
Carotte currently consists of three companies: Housekeeping, Food & Event, and Staff. Together, we provide comprehensive solutions for everything related to food, meetings, and service for our clients. The group was founded in 1982 and has offices in Stockholm, Jönköping, and Gothenburg.
Carotte Housekeeping is one of the fastest-growing companies within the Carotte Group and the cleaning industry. For us, Housekeeping means taking office cleaning to the next level. We provide high-quality cleaning services with a focus on the overall office environment.
We currently work with several clients who require these types of services, while also recognizing a growing market demand for a high-quality cleaning company. Our vision is to raise standards within the industry and deliver first-class housekeeping services to corporate clients in Stockholm, Jönköping, and Gothenburg.
ABOUT THE POSITION
Main Responsibilities
We are looking for Housekeepers/Cleaners to join Carotte Housekeeping in Gothenburg.
In this role, you will work at our clients' premises, carrying out a variety of cleaning tasks. We are looking for individuals interested in part-time positions at our exciting client locations. Working hours vary and include mornings, daytime, and evenings.
Full Job Description
We are looking for someone who takes pride in creating clean, welcoming, and pleasant environments for our clients.
You are motivated by quality and customer satisfaction. You are detail-oriented, responsible, efficient, service-minded, and have a keen eye for detail. You have a positive attitude and always strive to exceed customer expectations.
You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
Previous experience in commercial cleaning or similar work is required, as well as knowledge of Swedish or English.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
We look forward to receiving your application! Please apply by clicking the "Apply Now" button.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
Please note that we do not accept applications via email. However, if you have any questions or need further information, please feel free to contact us at mirey@carotte.se.

 Key Responsibilities:

We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.
